question: Determine which three lowest-level Reactome pathways (with TAS evidence) have the highest chi-squared statistics, considering only Homo sapiens targets associated with sorafenib under the conditions that the median assay value is ≤ 100 and both low and high assay values are ≤ 100 or null. For each of these three pathways, how many of these targets and non-targets lie within the pathway and outside it?
sql:
WITH sorafenib_targets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT i.target_uniprotID
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.interactions_v1` i
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.targetome_versioned.experiments_v1` e ON i.expID = e.expID
    WHERE i.drugID = 157
      AND i.targetSpecies = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND e.exp_assayValueMedian <= 100
      AND (e.exp_assayValueLow <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueLow IS NULL)
      AND (e.exp_assayValueHigh <= 100 OR e.exp_assayValueHigh IS NULL)
),
target_pes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.stable_id AS pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.physical_entity_v77` pe
    WHERE pe.uniprot_id IN (SELECT target_uniprotID FROM sorafenib_targets)
),
all_tas_homo AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.pe_stable_id
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    WHERE pe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND p.species = 'Homo sapiens'
),
total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tas_homo a JOIN target_pes t ON a.pe_stable_id = t.pe_stable_id) as total_targets,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_tas_homo) as total_tas_homo
),
pathway_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        p.stable_id AS pathway_stable_id,
        p.name AS pathway_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tp.pe_stable_id IS NOT NULL THEN pe.pe_stable_id END) AS targets_in,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pe.pe_stable_id) AS total_in
    FROM `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pe_to_pathway_v77` pe
    JOIN `isb-cgc-bq.reactome_versioned.pathway_v77` p ON pe.pathway_stable_id = p.stable_id
    LEFT JOIN target_pes tp ON pe.pe_stable_id = tp.pe_stable_id
    WHERE pe.evidence_code = 'TAS'
      AND p.species = 'Homo sapiens'
      AND p.lowest_level = TRUE
    GROUP BY p.stable_id, p.name
),
chi_squared AS (
    SELECT 
        ps.pathway_stable_id,
        ps.pathway_name,
        ps.targets_in,
        ps.total_in,
        tc.total_targets,
        tc.total_tas_homo,
        ps.targets_in AS a,
        ps.total_in - ps.targets_in AS b,
        tc.total_targets - ps.targets_in AS c,
        tc.total_tas_homo - ps.total_in AS d,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(
            SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_tas_homo, POWER(SAFE_SUBTRACT(SAFE_MULTIPLY(ps.targets_in, tc.total_tas_homo - ps.total_in), SAFE_MULTIPLY(ps.total_in - ps.targets_in, tc.total_targets - ps.targets_in)), 2)),
            SAFE_MULTIPLY(ps.total_in, SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_tas_homo - ps.total_in + tc.total_targets - ps.targets_in, SAFE_MULTIPLY(tc.total_targets, tc.total_tas_homo - ps.targets_in)))
        ) AS chi_sq
    FROM pathway_stats ps
    CROSS JOIN total_counts tc
)
SELECT 
    pathway_stable_id,
    pathway_name,
    chi_sq,
    targets_in AS targets_in_pathway,
    total_targets - targets_in AS targets_outside_pathway,
    total_in - targets_in AS non_targets_in_pathway,
    total_tas_homo - total_in AS non_targets_outside_pathway
FROM chi_squared
ORDER BY chi_sq DESC
LIMIT 3
